text: Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, ruled in gratitude. And then came the one thing no kingdom can stop.
"And when We decreed for him death, nothing indicated to the jinn his death except a creature of the earth, eating his staff."
He was still leaning on his staff, and the jinn kept working, not knowing he had passed away.
"Then it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment."
The jinn, who offered to bring a throne before a man could stand up... did not know the unseen. Only Allah knows it.
